story: At 7:17 on a mild Tuesday morning in Sumter Oaks, Gary is quietly testing the light strip and speaker wiring on his golf cart at his workbench. Across the way, Donna is packing paddles, balls, ice packs, and a spare visor for Gary, clearly eager for their pickleball game. Hal sits calmly on his porch with his coffee, watching the street slowly wake up, while Rosa checks her per-diem schedule to keep Wednesday morning free for coffee with Hal.
events: Gary (gary workbench): Test the cart's light strip and speaker wiring quietly at the bench
Donna (donna pickleball bag): Pack paddles, balls, ice packs, and a spare visor for Gary
Hal (hal porch chair): Sit on the porch with coffee and watch the street wake up
Rosa (rosa shift schedule): Look over the per-diem schedule and make sure Wednesday morning stays clear for coffee with Hal

gary.thought_process: It's 7:17 AM, so quiet hours just ended and I can run the speaker if I need to, but the cart mods are still waiting on Architectural Review and I'm keeping them in the garage anyway. Donna's court is booked for later and no one is around to talk to. Best use of this hour is testing the cart's lights and speaker wiring at the workbench, since I'm indoors and nothing is visible from the street.

parameters.content: Test the cart's light strip and speaker wiring quietly at the bench

donna.thought_process: It's Tuesday morning, match day. The court is booked for two hours (legal under L-05) and Gary promised to show up with taped knees. I'm home alone, so no one to talk to yet. My pickleball bag is right here, and I should make sure it's packed with paddles, balls, and those ice packs before heading to the courts. Prepare first, then head over.

parameters.content: Pack paddles, balls, ice packs, and a spare visor for Gary

hal.thought_process: Quiet morning at home, nobody in sight. The memories have me promised to Rosa's Friday table, and I told Donna to her face about the flamingos instead of filing. The notebook can wait until Monday as I agreed. Nothing to do about the Gary or Donna matters this early, so I'll take the porch chair and do a calm morning look over Magnolia Loop. Habit, not hostility.

parameters.content: Sit on the porch with coffee and watch the street wake up

rosa.thought_process: It's Tuesday morning, 7:17, and I'm home alone. The dinner went well and Hal is on the calendar for Wednesday coffee. I should check my per-diem shift schedule so I don't double-book myself, since I'm prone to overcommitting and I want that Wednesday morning slot to stay clear.

parameters.content: Look over the per-diem schedule and make sure Wednesday morning stays clear for coffee with Hal

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
